name: btn: Delete SalesTransaction
purpose: Button: deletes the selected sales transaction by calling Delete SalesTransaction in karbon_kontroller, then shows a success or error dialog and closes the window on success.
writes: delete: SalesTransaction (via karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/560, step 8, record with id = SalesTransaction::id)
open_question: The delete effect and its rules (the dialog says billable time returns to unbilled) are in karbon_kontroller script 560. Only fires when SalesTransaction::id is not empty.

name: btn: Go To Payment

callers: none found (layouts reference a same-named script id 277, not 216)

name: btn Send Customer to QBO

open_question: Result of the QBO send is the whole logic; see LedgerLink script 302.

name: btn Customer Open In QBO

open_question: The Open in QB script likely opens a URL (not in this share).

name: btn: Unlock Sales Transaction ( Id )
purpose: Button: unlocks a sales transaction for editing. Blocks the action when the transaction date is on or before the system book-close date, otherwise calls Lock/Unlock Sales Transaction (Lock=false) in karbon_kontroller and opens the Invoice or SalesReceipt layout.
open_question: Book-close rule is enforced here in the UI script (step 9): the target must enforce it on the server.

name: btn: Lock SalesTransaction
purpose: Button: commits the open record and locks the sales transaction through Lock/Unlock Sales Transaction (Lock=true) in karbon_kontroller, then opens the view-only Invoice or SalesReceipt layout.
open_question: Lock state lives in karbon_kontroller script 599.
